question: ¿Cuántos ensayos clínicos sobre melanoma prueban el fármaco nivolumab?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'melanoma')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (i.name ILIKE '%nivolumab%' OR i.name ILIKE '%opdivo%' OR i.name ILIKE '%bms-936558%' OR i.name ILIKE '%ono-4538%'))
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (o.name ILIKE '%nivolumab%' OR o.name ILIKE '%opdivo%' OR o.name ILIKE '%bms-936558%' OR o.name ILIKE '%ono-4538%')))
